rv.q: Marianne Elliott's rich and propulsive new production of Who's Afraid of Virginia Woolf @sohoplace skillfully avoids the quicksand, ensuring the audience live through the wreckage alongside the characters as we're all invited to an afterparty with Martha and George.

cn.t: Critics hail this production of Albee's masterful drama as a triumph, praising its deliciously layered exploration of marriage and illusion. The complex, wordy text remains as raw and relevant today as when written.
